title: 18 cubes in a tetrahedron

contribution.method:
Batch of 217 witnesses in 22 problems (`MANIFEST.json` + `records/<record_id>.json` + `SUMMARY.tsv`), each below the current `records/SUMMARY.csv` entry (main at 1a9535ed, checked 2026-11-14). Every record passes `verify_general.py` (VALID) and `certify_general.py` (CERTIFIED) from that commit locally, run on the files extracted from the archive. The changes against the current records: median -0.06 %, largest -2.46 %; 5 records improve by ≥ 1 %, 80 by ≥ 0.1 %.

**Relation to earlier submissions.** The public records were rebuilt after #108, #112, #123, #130 and #131 were merged (main 1a9535ed); every record here is below the value in that archive and below the values in open submissions.

**Against PolyPack.** I also compared with PolyPack's published records (https://github.com/sinkomr/PolyPack, `data/polyhedra/records.json`, fetched 2026-11-14) and kept only records that are below both the archive and PolyPack (95 of these records have a PolyPack value; `SUMMARY.tsv` lists both values, `polypack_s`, `change_vs_best`).

**How the records were made.** `found_by`, `credit` and `method` identify where each record starts; `method` or `refinement` gives the steps.

- *Refinements of catalogue records* (126): a contact-preserving descent (sequential linear programming with the contacts as inequalities) started from the catalogue record named in `refinement` (for some, a randomised multi-start search from perturbed copies of that record comes first; `refinement` says so). `found_by`, `credit` and `method` are the catalogue record's own, copied verbatim; my part is in `refined_by` and `refinement_credit`. For 9 of them the start was the record for a different n and the first n pieces were kept (`derived_from`). Rigidity analysis and code: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23630728
- *Layer-by-row and lattice constructions* (25): structured constructions with all pieces in one orientation. For cubes, the pieces are stacked in parallel layers and each layer is filled with rows
